Tokyo atlas

This is a map of Tokyo with layers you can switch on. You can lay each layer over an old map of the city from one of six periods.

The layers stand on their own. They do not depend on any walk. There are four: the famous neighbourhoods of Tokyo, industrial zones, how well off each ward and city is, and which party group people there voted for. Tap any shape to read its name and a note.

The cherry blossom marks Ueno Park; when it is off the map, a blossom chip at the edge points to it. The gold chrysanthemum marks the Imperial Palace.

The last two cover today only. If you pick an old map with one of them on, the page says so instead of drawing anything.

Neighbourhood town boundaries: 2020 Population Census small-area boundary data, Statistics Bureau of Japan (出典：政府統計の総合窓口(e-Stat)（https://www.e-stat.go.jp/）「令和2年国勢調査 小地域（町丁・字等）境界データ」（総務省統計局）を加工して作成).
